description: eSIM data plans for one destination, cheapest first, with prices. No sign-up: the person orders, pays, and gets an eSIM QR code. Give a country or region name or code, for example "United Kingdom", "GB" or "Europe". Each plan has an order_url: our own order page for the person. Prices are in US dollars outside Nigeria and in naira in Nigeria; pass currency to choose.

currency.description: Optional: USD or NGN. By default prices are in US dollars outside Nigeria and in naira inside Nigeria, from where the request comes from.

location.description: Country or region name or code, for example United Kingdom, GB, Europe or europe.

name: search_esim_plans
